findingSummary.description:
Aggregated finding counters for the account, broken down across several dimensions.
Used to render a grouped findings table: each bucket carries the number of findings
behind it, so a group can be expanded into `findingList` using the same filter.
findingSummary.name: findingSummary

definition.description: Response payload for the `findingSummary` query.

summary.description: Computed finding summary for the requested filter.
summary.name: summary

definition.description:
Finding counters grouped by each supported dimension. Dimensions derived from the owning check
are returned as plain lists; dimensions read from the finding row itself are wrapped, because
their value set is open-ended and the returned buckets may be truncated.

A check carrying no value for a dimension contributes to no bucket of it, so a breakdown can sum
up to less than `total`. Multi-valued dimensions such as compliance frameworks can exceed it.

appInstanceBreakdown.description: Breakdown by the finding's application instance.
appInstanceBreakdown.name: appInstanceBreakdown

definition.description: Buckets of a breakdown dimension read from the finding row itself.

items.description: Buckets ordered by `findingCount` descending, truncated to the requested limit.
items.name: items

definition.description: One value of a breakdown dimension read from the finding row itself.

checkCount.description: Number of distinct checks contributing findings with this value.
checkCount.name: checkCount

findingCount.description: Number of findings with this value.
findingCount.name: findingCount

key.description: The finding attribute value, or null for findings that carry no value for this dimension.
key.name: key

definition.name: PostureFindingSummaryValueBucket

total.description:
Total number of distinct values, so clients can detect truncation. Equal to the size of
`items` for the enum-valued dimensions, which can never be truncated.
total.name: total
